text: User: I want you to make a personal static website for myself -- make it very old school and simple -- it should have a /stuff with one-liner of the things I work on [...] for the /stuff page, look at my most active and most recent repos on github and also cross-reference with projects I've talked about on nostr. Use whatever I have said as part of the text that presents the different projects in /stuff, not necessarily verbatim, but more to capture the essence or cool things about each project.
